summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of the Keilor-only course + Pair Scoring flow. All 9 backend pytest cases pass (Keilor course detail with correct par/distance/index, nearby returns only Keilor, session creation with 6-digit join_code + 4-digit course_short_id, host+guest join, 3rd device rejected with 409, invalid code 404, pending→verified→mismatch→re-submit-verified cross-check, putts-only mismatch, finish). Full frontend E2E in two isolated browser contexts (simulating two devices with distinct localStorage) verified: Home shows 'Keilor Golf Course · 18 holes · Par 69' with SOLO and PLAY WITH A MARKER buttons; auto-generated 4-digit member IDs are distinct per device (e.g. 7305 vs 1184); host tap Create shows 6-digit join code and Waiting state; guest joins → both auto-navigate to /pair-round within 2s; hole 1 shows Par 4 / 317m / Index 11 (matches spec); when devices submit differing values row turns RED with badge "Scores don't match. Both re-enter and re-submit to continue." and Next Hole is hidden; after re-submitting matching values badge becomes 'Verified. Tap Next Hole to continue.' and Next Hole appears on both devices; Pair Summary renders YOU + MARKER cards and filename preview matches format MEMBERID-YYYYMMDDHHMM-COURSESHORTID (e.g. 4023-202608040522-9748). No deprecated Expo packages detected in the pair-scoring files.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py FAMOUS_COURSES constant (lines 393-404) is defined but never used - dead code, consider removing.
pair-round.tsx rowState logic (lines 190-199) has an unreachable branch: the last `mySubmission && !bothSubmitted ? 'waiting'` collapses with the branch above it - minor cleanup only.
Backend allows any device_id string; no validation of member_id being 4 digits server-side. Frontend enforces it, but a malformed client could bypass. Low priority.
seed_data_creation: None. Each test creates its own session via API and uses unique uuid device_ids so no cleanup needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: https://greens-scorecard.preview.emergentagent.com. Reusable pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_pair_flow.py covers full pair-scoring flow. For frontend two-device tests use separate browser contexts and call localStorage.clear() + reload on the second context before navigating so the device_id/member_id are unique. Values in the stepper start at par (score) or 2 (putts) on first press when previous value is null.
